## Validation

- [ ] Meaningful regression tests cover the operation and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Existing tests remain intact and pass.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Desktop tests pass if UI or Electron integration changed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog describe the actual behavior and limitations.
